headline: Francis Marion draws at Flagler as winning run ends
dek: Flagler held Francis Marion to a draw on Saturday in the last match on the schedule, ending the program's winning run. Francis Marion still finishes with seventeen wins, more than any other conference program, having scored 42 goals and conceded just seventeen.
displaced_by: Francis Marion drew at Flagler on November 21, ending its winning run.
